newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's April crude exports above the norm -Pemex.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's April crude exports above the norm -Pemex.

text.p: Mexico's April crude export volume of 1.817 million barrels per day (bpd) was exceptional and is unlikely to be the norm, a crude trader with state oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) said on Friday.
Pemex said it exported an average 1.665 bpd of crude in "April was a very
special month in which a lot of factors came together. Volume will probably be more like the numbers we saw in May," said the trader, who declined to be named.
Mexico's average crude exports for the first five months of the year were 1.664 million bpd, compared to 1.544 million bpd in 1996 and 1.305 million bpd in 1995.
